caveat: Strong temporal autocorrelation makes naive persistence a deceptively strong baseline on this stream (experimental_protocol.md section 1.2). Used for comparability with prior work, never as primary evidence.
citation: Souza et al., Challenges in benchmarking stream learning algorithms with real-world data, Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery, 2020.
reason_for_inclusion: Tier B: a real stream whose drift mechanism is known by construction rather than inferred, which makes it a useful check on the forecastability taxonomy.
shift_type: physically induced covariate drift (controlled temperature change)
